name: Kat Hickey
review: I have been a consistent student of Kat's for seven months and have learned so much, not only about the practice of Yoga but the practice of being in place of doing. Her music brings together modern trends with healing foundation, regularly finding the bass line affording increased grounding. While Kat certainly challenges me, it is with gentle invitation to accept while growing, embrace while changing, and savor while improving. This is a delicate harmony I have only experienced with her and words won't do the experience justice. Highly recommend taking class with her and seeing your own development emerge in her tender care, one class, one pose, one breath at a time.

name: Nicole Parsons
review:
Kat has such a graceful and artistic way of holding space for others. She doesn’t simply teach yoga; she embodies what she teaches in the way she moves through the world, with curiosity, creativity, presence, and genuine care for the people around her.

Her classes invite you to stay with yourself, especially in those moments of uncertainty when a pose asks you to breathe, explore, and resist the urge to rush toward what comes next. There is both intention and freedom in the way she teaches, creating space to be challenged without losing connection to yourself.

What stands out most is how deeply Kat cares about her students. You feel seen in her presence, while still being given the space to have an experience that is entirely your own. Practicing with her feels less like being told how yoga should look and more like being invited to discover what it can feel like in your own body.
